faq_metadata.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_metadata.description: Authoritative FAQ policies, delivery structure, and licensing terms for Business and Personal AI Training.

walkaway_guarantee.summary: Walk away owing nothing if not satisfied after the first 5 days of completed training.
walkaway_guarantee.refundable_installments: Strictly zero advance payment required; progressive installment invoicing.

ip_licensing.policy_name: Full Production IP and Apache 2.0 Licensing
ip_licensing.summary: All code, workflows, custom tooling, and multi-agent infrastructure developed belong 100% to the client. All written guides, digital curricula, and documentation are licensed under Apache 2.0.

delivery_schedule.business_flagship: 2 months total (60 days): 30 days live training (Mon-Fri, weekends off, 4 hours per day) + 30 days dedicated support, billed in 10 evenly spaced payment milestones over 60 days, on completion of which Apache 2.0 license to all training materials is granted
delivery_schedule.personal_flagship: 2 months total (60 days): 30 days live training (Mon-Fri, weekends off, 4 hours per day) + 30 days dedicated support, billed in 10 evenly spaced payment milestones over 60 days, on completion of which Apache 2.0 license to all training materials is granted
delivery_schedule.individual_service: 10 days total: 5 days live training + 5 days dedicated support (Mon-Fri, weekends off, 4 hours per day, $0 extra charge for support)

cohort_rules.business_flagship: Up to 10 participants included in base tier; additional seats at +$100 USD per seat scaled by country parity (max 20 seats)
cohort_rules.personal_flagship: Up to 10 participants included in base tier; additional seats at +$100 USD per seat scaled by country parity (max 20 seats)
cohort_rules.individual_business: Up to 10 participants included in base tier; additional seats at +$100 USD per seat scaled by country parity (max 20 seats)
cohort_rules.individual_personal: Up to 10 participants included in base tier; additional seats at +$100 USD per seat scaled by country parity (max 20 seats)

training_materials_licensing.terms: Zero charge for training materials: All training materials will be provided to the client with an Apache 2.0 license for internal use, commercial use, or even resale with only one requirement - attribution to the original author. The license will not be provided if the training ends early.
